threshold_note: threshold is rolling (window per lookback); threshold_value is the latest rolling value — see winner_trade_log.csv for the full threshold path
strategy_description: Long SPY when the lagged ISM Services signal is below its threshold; otherwise cash. (Countercyclical orientation: weak PMI/gap = risk-on after lag.)
lead_description: Signal lead = 3 month(s); L1 is the monthly real-time floor because prior-month PMI is released early in the following month
notes: Mode 3, feat_ism_services_spy. Tournament: 4880 strategy combos (+1 benchmark, valid=False per ECON-T4), 3385 valid. Winner by ECON-T3 cascade (resolved at step 5; 2 tied at step 1). Strategy returns are gross of transaction costs; 5 bps sensitivity in tournament_validation_20260618/. ISM Services PMI behaves as a coincident/sentiment survey in this sample: Toda-Yamamoto Granger finds NO monthly forward causality (ISM Services->SPY n.s. at all lags 1-12) and STRONG reverse causality (SPY->ISM Services significant at every lag). Robustness caveats: winner bootstrap p = 0.073 (NOT significant at 5% vs resampled B&H); in-sample Sharpe -0.11 vs OOS 1.54 (IS/OOS inconsistency suggests a favorable OOS draw); CP1 durability verdict 'episode_concentrated'; rolling-correlation stability 'moderately_stable'. OOS exposure is sparse (mean position 0.27) — most of the DD advantage comes from being in cash.
